infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We need your location to show nearby lost pets and help reunite animals with their owners.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: We need your location to show nearby lost pets and send you alerts when pets are found near you.
